name: @cms/api
description: Authoritative Hono/OpenAPI 3.1 transport over @cms/core and @cms/storage. Sole authority surface for web/CLI/MCP; thin transport, never reimplementing policy or state-machine logic. RFC 9457 Problem Details localized in en/es; idempotent writes; optimistic concurrency; tenant-scoped; human-authorization-only for approve/publish/rollback; canonical-written vs live-propagated deploy receipts; one-action rollback authorized by current policy without credential replay or impersonation.
